rights: Original procedural vector artwork created for this project. No third-party images, characters, logos, fonts, or textures are embedded. Permission is granted to use, modify, and integrate these assets in Living Walls.
important: These are animated SVG scene assets. Android app integration must render them with an SVG-capable WebView/renderer or recreate their layers/effects in the native WallpaperService. Test actual live wallpaper playback on device.
